log: [Spring, Year 1  Day 1  07:00] Wat Ashdown: They say a sage lives in a hut at the north edge of the village, and that he teaches fire to those who can pay.
[Spring, Year 1  Day 1  07:00] Day 1 begins in the village.
[Spring, Year 1  Day 1  12:00] Gwen  attacked Reginald Greenhill.
[Spring, Year 1  Day 1  12:00] Gwen  attacked John Greenhill.
[Spring, Year 1  Day 1  12:00] John Greenhill the tavernkeeper has died (slain by Gwen ).
[Spring, Year 1  Day 1  12:00] The post of tavernkeeper, left by John Greenhill, is open: an apprentice or a newcomer will take it.
